scope: Read-only documentation and donor code review; no hardware register access, clock change, CCF registration or production build modification.

registers.name: CPU_BACK_PLL_CTRL
registers.access: R/W control, bit28 read-only lock; no read-clear described

registers.name: CPU_SLOW_CLK_SEL
registers.access: bits1:0 R/W; reads have no stated side effect

values.3: matching CPU_L/B_PLL divided by external P
reserved by manual; do not report a verified frequency

external_divider.note: Applied to mux3 PLL output; not blindly applied to all parent selections.

dsu_conflict.decision: If observed mux4/5, retain raw data and flag unresolved source mapping; do not fabricate a definite frequency.

little_big_dsu_ctrl.qualification: Donor CCU models N with offset0 and external power-of-two divider, while assuming internal divider fields stay at their initialized values. The simple f_input*N/2^ext formula is only valid when internal divisors are 1 and modulation is not active.

cpu_back_manual.qualification: Manual formula. Donor ccu_nm declaration at ccu-sun60iw2-cpupll.c:45-61 models different factor encoding, so this is not a fully cross-validated measured frequency.

pll_formulas.input: The board's established DCXO is 26 MHz; do not confuse derived PLL_REF=24 MHz with CPU PLL input or assume a generic 24 MHz crystal.
pll_formulas.ready_bits: CTRL enable31/LDO30/lock-detect29/lock28/output27; CTRL update26 must be stable/clear before reporting a stable setting.
pll_formulas.status_conflict: Control register description gives N=raw and default N=20 gives 480 MHz at 24 MHz, matching donor offset0. CTRL_STAT descriptions elsewhere say N=raw+1; treat this as a documentation inconsistency, preserve CTRL and CTRL_STAT raw values, and do not apply +1 solely from the status text.
pll_formulas.modulation: Capture PAT0, PAT1 and LFM. Active fractional/SDM/linear-frequency modulation makes an integer-only decode nominal, not a clock measurement. Repeated identical samples can establish stable register settings, not precise physical frequency.

read_safety.method: Independent init-only module with readl of the enumerated aligned words; no clock/reset/regulator registration and no writes.
read_safety.semantics: Selected CTRL, CLK, PAT and LFM fields are ordinary R/W or R; CTRL_STAT is read-only. None of the proposed reads are described as clear-on-read. Avoid unlock interrupt status/control and gating keys in a read-only frequency probe.
read_safety.boundary: Documentation supports non-mutating read semantics. It does not alone prove nonsecure bus access succeeds on the running firmware; actual accessibility remains a hardware result.
read_safety.vendor_calls_forbidden_for_readonly_prob: Do not call donor CPU CCU probe: lines274-292 write PAT/LFM/UPD. Do not use vendor ccu_nkmp recalc as a presumed pure read: lines191-193 can update SDM settings.
read_safety.false_proxies: CNTFRQ/timer frequency, BogoMIPS, missing cpufreq sysfs and device-tree clock-frequency alone are not actual CPU clock measurements.
